errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Invalid data. Check the form and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.username: The username must be 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.conflict: Someone else edited this page while you were writing. Your changes are below: copy them, reload the page and add them again.
errors.categoryLoop: A category can't be inside itself or one of its subcategories.
errors.tagTaken: A tag with this name already exists.
errors.selfDemote: You can't remove your own Admin role or disable yourself.
errors.lastAdmin: There must be at least one active Admin.
errors.notFound: This page doesn't exist or you don't have permission to see it.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again shortly.

auth.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long phrase is safer than a complicated word.
auth.inviteOnly: No account? Ask the wiki administrator for an invite link.

setup.title: Welcome to Crooked Shelf
setup.intro: First setup: name your wiki and create the administrator account. You can invite the other players later.

invite.title: Join the wiki
invite.intro: You've been invited as {role}. Choose a username and password.
invite.invalid: This invite isn't valid: it may have expired or already been used.

roles.adminHint: Everything: settings, users, invites, and all Game Master powers.
roles.masterHint: Creates and edits all pages, sees and writes secrets, manages categories and tags.
roles.playerHint: Reads player pages, creates pages and edits their own and those open to players.

visibility.publicHint: also visitors without an account, if visitor access is on

home.emptyText: Every great campaign starts with a page. Write a place, a character or the recap of the first session.

page.title: Title
page.tagsHint: Comma separated, for example: North, Tavern, Quest

editor.heading: Heading {n}
editor.linkPrompt: Link address (leave empty to remove it)
editor.wikiLinkHint: Link to another page: type [[ and the title
editor.hint: You can use Markdown: # heading, - list, **bold**, > quote. Type [[ to link another page. Esc leaves the editor.
editor.altPrompt: Describe the image in a few words for people who can't see it (leave empty if it's only decorative)

categories.deleteHint: Pages stay, without a category; subcategories move up one level.

tags.empty: No tags yet. Add them while editing a page.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.introUser: Reading preferences are saved in your profile and apply on every device.
prefs.introGuest: Preferences are saved in this browser.
prefs.fontHint: Atkinson and OpenDyslexic help people with reading difficulties.
prefs.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sessions on other devices have been closed.

admin.allowVisitorsHint: People without an account can read public pages. When off, logging in is always required.
admin.usersIntro: Change roles or disable accounts. To add people use
admin.invitesIntro: Create an invite link and send it to the person (message, email…). It works only once.
admin.inviteOnce: Copy the link now: for security it won't be shown again.

files.tooBig: The file is too big (max 25 MB).
files.badType: Unsupported format: use PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.

fields.title: Infobox
fields.hint: Short facts shown in a side box, e.g. “Alignment: Chaotic good”. Values can contain [[Page]].
fields.label: Field name {n}

session.title: Session recap
session.hint: The recap automatically appears in the campaign timeline.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Templates prepare a page with ready-made sections and fields. Built-in ones can't be changed: the Game Master can create new ones.
templates.choose: Where do you want to start?
templates.isSession: Session recap: goes into the campaign timeline.
templates.sessionCheck: It's a session recap (number, date, entry in the campaign timeline)
templates.fieldsHint: One per line, e.g. Alignment. They become the infobox fields.
templates.deleteHint: Pages already created stay as they are.
templates.secretHint: Write here what only the Game Master should know.
templates.pcHint: A player's character: backstory and goals.
templates.sessionHint: What happened at the table: goes into the campaign timeline.
templates.houseruleHint: A rule of your table and why.

timeline.worldIntro: The history of the world: ages, wars, legends.
timeline.campaignIntro: What happened at the table, session after session.
timeline.lineHint: Scroll the strip sideways, or use the arrow keys after selecting it with Tab.
timeline.approxHint: Optional, e.g. “about 300 years ago”: shown instead of the date.
timeline.descHint: You can write [[Page]] to link a page.
timeline.pageHint: Optional: the title of an existing page.
timeline.errDate: This date doesn't exist in the world calendar.
timeline.errNeedYear: At least the year is needed.
timeline.errNeedAnyDate: The real date or the in-world date is needed.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.summary: {months} months, {days} days in a normal year.
calendar.leapSkipText: Exception: not every {skip} years, except every {keep}.
calendar.presetHint: Fills the form below; press Save to use it.
calendar.presetLoaded: Calendar loaded into the form: check it and press Save.
calendar.monthsHint: One month per line: “Name: days”. Add * for a festival day outside the months, e.g. “Midwinter: 1 *”.
calendar.weekdaysHint: One per line (or comma separated). Leave empty if not needed.
calendar.erasHint: One per line: “Name | abbreviation | first year”, e.g. “Dalereckoning | DR | 1”.
calendar.leapHint: Leave “Every how many years” empty if your world has no leap years. The month is given by number.
calendar.todayHint: Optional: used to show “120 years ago” next to events.
calendar.saved: Calendar saved: the timeline has been reordered.
calendar.errMonth: A month isn't written correctly: use “Name: days”.
calendar.errEra: An era isn't written correctly: use “Name | abbreviation | year”.
calendar.errLeap: Leap years aren't set correctly: check the numbers.
calendar.errToday: Today's in-world date doesn't exist in the calendar.

maps.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, max 25 MB.
maps.parentHint: For nested maps: kingdom, city, building.
maps.scaleHint: How wide the map is in the world, left to right: used to measure distances.
maps.deleteConfirm: Yes, I want to delete “{title}” with all its pins
maps.errParent: A map can't be inside itself.
maps.errPosition: The pin position is outside the map.
maps.measureHint: Click two or more points on the map to measure the distance.
maps.addHint: Click on the map where you want the pin.
maps.pinPlaced: New pin at {x}, {y}: fill in the form below.
maps.keyboardHint: With the keyboard: Tab to enter the map, arrows to move, + and − to zoom, Tab to go from pin to pin and Enter to open one. All pins are also in the list below.
maps.linkedPageHint: A page title; if it doesn't exist yet, it can be created.
maps.layerDeleted: Layer deleted: its pins now have no layer.
